next_scope: 06.4 chronological simulator with shared stock, sale fulfillment and return eligibility
limitations: Single review and independent future receipt scheduling; no chronological multi-day sales/demand simulator or source 2.6 integration.
Coverage certificates describe observed ledger stream, not latent demand or future correction completeness; generator must derive coverage from processed windows.
Supplier reliability is probability of no disruption; base lead time has a two-point mean +/- std distribution before rounding/clamping.
Disruptions delay and partially deliver; eventual full receipt is guaranteed. No permanent failure, cancellation or approval workflow.
No future realized ETA is exposed as a promise at ordering; v1 promise uses the known quote.
Full generator report contains separate simulation truth and is not an API/feature export.
DATA-06, snapshots, source gates and inventory-dependent model acceptance remain open.
